Certainly, I can help you with that. You would like to add one extra checked bag and a pram to your booking BK-SKY001. Is that correct?

"Yes, that's right. My baby will be traveling in a car seat, but I'll also have a pram that needs to be on the flight with us. Can you let me know if this is okay and what the additional fees would be for each of them?"

An extra checked bag costs £35. Prams are usually carried free of charge, but I need to confirm the specific policy for car seats.

Let me check the baggage allowance policy for you regarding prams and car seats.

"That's good to know about the pram being free, thanks. And just to clarify, my baby is only 2 months old, so they'll be traveling in a car seat that can also fit on the aircraft. Is that acceptable for the purpose of this flight?"

The information I have doesn't specifically detail policies for car seats that fit on the aircraft. However, I can confirm that a pram can be carried free of charge in addition to your normal baggage allowance. An extra checked bag would cost £35.

Would you like me to go ahead and add one extra checked bag and the pram to your booking BK-SKY001?

"Yes, that sounds good, thank you for letting me know about the pram. And yes, please can you add the £35 for the extra checked bag to my booking, so everything is up to date. Can I confirm what the updated total will be?"

I have successfully added one extra checked bag and a pram to your booking BK-SKY001. The cost for the extra checked bag is £35, and the pram is free of charge.

Regarding the updated total, the system shows a total price of £364.0 for your booking after these additions. Please note that payment for any additional services is processed online via the booking confirmation email. You will receive an updated confirmation email with a secure payment link.

Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
"No, that's all thank you so much, Sky. Everything looks good and I appreciate your help in getting my booking sorted out. I'll make sure to check my email for the updated confirmation email."

You're most welcome, Alex. I'm glad I could help you get everything sorted for your trip. Please do check your email for the updated confirmation.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
